Make every
contribution count.

AI prepares the draft.

privacy.title: Privacy and data use
privacy.intro: This notice describes how OpenSelf processes data. The operator manages the instance you use.
privacy.accountBody: After sign-in, OpenSelf stores your GitHub identity, preferences and sessions. GitHub tokens and personal DeepSeek keys are encrypted on the server with AES-256-GCM. Browser APIs do not return plaintext keys.
privacy.codeBody: Repository information, issues and PR diffs are read in response to your actions. Drafts, review results, edits, usage and publication records are stored in the database. Read caches are isolated by user.
privacy.aiBody: AI features send relevant descriptions, diffs, repository conventions or historical comments to the configured DeepSeek service. Private repositories require separate consent. The model cannot publish; you approve publication in the draft queue.
privacy.retentionBody: Revoking access removes stored tokens, personal keys and sessions. Drafts and historical records remain. History has no automatic retention deadline; contact the instance operator to delete those records.
privacy.extensionBody: The extension reads the active tab URL to identify repositories, PRs and new issue pages. It does not scrape GitHub page DOM; it only fills issue inputs when you click Fill page. It never clicks Submit for you.
privacy.controlBody: You can disable private repository access, remove your API key, edit or discard drafts, and revoke GitHub access. GitHub and DeepSeek apply their own policies to data processed by their services.

tasks.description: Track progress, recover results, cancel further work or resume saved tasks.
tasks.leaveNote: You can leave this page. Return through the dashboard or AI tasks. Identical active submissions reuse the existing task.
tasks.resumeNote: Completed batches are retained. Cancellation stops further work and attempts to abort pending model requests; usage already incurred remains billable. Resuming a scan reuses valid batches for the same version.
